title: Upgrade Credit Allowed against a Room Upgrade on a Hotel Folio
content:
Where a room upgrade stands on the folio of a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range, an upgrade credit is allowed for each night the upgrade was charged, according to how many such nights stand there. Where a room upgrade stands on the folio for 5 nights or more, the upgrade credit is 20.00 USD for each night the upgrade was charged. Where it stands for 2 nights or more but fewer than 5, the upgrade credit is 10.00 USD for each night charged. Where it stands for fewer than 2 nights, the upgrade credit is nil for each night charged.

**Read as input, judgement and result, on hypothetical folios.**

> Input: 6 nights of room upgrade on the folio.
> Judgement: 6 nights is not fewer than 5.
> Result: an upgrade credit of 20.00 USD a night, which multiplied by those 6 nights covers 120.00 USD.

> Input: 5 nights of room upgrade on the folio.
> Judgement: 5 is the foot of the top band.
> Result: an upgrade credit of 20.00 USD a night, covering 100.00 USD.

> Input: 4 nights of room upgrade on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 5 but not fewer than 2.
> Result: an upgrade credit of 10.00 USD a night, covering 40.00 USD.

> Input: 2 nights of room upgrade on the folio.
> Judgement: 2 is the foot of the middle band.
> Result: an upgrade credit of 10.00 USD a night, covering 20.00 USD.

> Input: 1 night of room upgrade on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 2.
> Result: an upgrade credit of nil a night, covering nothing.
